## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** Baseline engine uses qty=28 on winner days (per J's anchor trades), requiring $25K+ account for full size; $1K paper account realizes ~14% of headline P&L.
2. **Sample bias:** J anchor days n=6 (3 winners, 3 losers); selection method fixed per OP-16 source-of-truth; overfit risk low as days are discrete historical events with no parameter tuning.
3. **Out-of-sample:** Baseline OOS Sharpe=4.340 (from [STRUCTURE_VETO_DIR_VS_TREND] base Sharpe) over full OPRA 2025-01-02..2026-06-18; walk-forward OOS ratio unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest.
4. **Real-fills:** Baseline takes all 3 J winners with full P&L (per [STRUCTURE_VETO_DIR_VS_TREND] "anchor edge_capture unchanged $780"); real-fills validation on top 3 J days PASSES (engine behavior matches J's trades); NEEDS-REAL-FILLS for loser days.
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: 5/06 loser (if engine takes full −$300); max drawdown: −$2,273 (per [STRUCTURE_VETO_DIR_VS_TREND] baseline maxDD); blow-up scenario: consecutive loser days with full losses exceeding daily −50% kill switch.
6. **Concentration:** Top-5 days = unknown % of P&L; baseline winner days contribute 100% of edge_capture (1542) but loser days subtract $762; concentration disclosure requires full P&L breakdown -- unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest.
